articles.title: Albert Dalrymple, 80, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Albert Dalrymple for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Albert Dalrymple died in June at home on Eastgate Avenue, at the age of 80. Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Albert Dalrymple spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foxglove Heights Neighbors in his or her name.

body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

Andre Gilroy, Eastgate
